opening.argument: The material presents a branded Bitcoin-mining and infrastructure operation, with rows of network equipment, a stated total capacity of more than 150 MW, and the name BLOCKMINE. Those observable details establish an educational or operational demonstration rather than a concrete offer to viewers: there is no stated investment return, required payment, or requested audience action. The title identifies the subject as “Long-term Bitcoin Mining,” while the footage focuses on hardware and facility scale. The accompanying description primarily advertises an ordinary commercial video-production service, and general references to crypto, trading, and NFT promotions do not by themselves establish solicitation. Nothing supplied here shows what viewers are asked to purchase, contribute, or do.
